args.title: Trim carriage returns in parser to support CRLF line endings
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim carriage returns (\r) when splitting lines or handling text in parseStatement in src/ingest/parser.ts so Windows line endings (CRLF) do not leave trailing \r characters on fields causing column-count mismatches.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Files with CRLF line endings split using text.split('\n') retain a trailing carriage return (\r) on fields, leading to column-count mismatches and 'Malformed row' IngestError messages. Trimming carriage returns in parseStatement resolves this issue for Windows line endings.
